subtitle: Lesson 19 · Azure Networking

eyebrow: Basic SKU is retired — Standard is the default now

code:
az network lb create \
  --resource-group rg-network-demo \
  --name lb-web \
  --sku Standard \
  --public-ip-address pip-lb \
  --frontend-ip-name feConfig \
  --backend-pool-name beWebPool
caption: Layer 4: Azure Load Balancer distributes TCP/UDP traffic by IP and port only.

code:
az network lb probe create \
  --lb-name lb-web --name healthProbe \
  --protocol Tcp --port 80

az network lb rule create \
  --lb-name lb-web --name httpRule \
  --protocol Tcp --frontend-port 80 --backend-port 80 \
  --frontend-ip-name feConfig --backend-pool-name beWebPool \
  --probe-name healthProbe
caption: Unhealthy backend instances are pulled out of rotation automatically.
